say:1:1430215101:1.text: Who else could it be besides those stinking nobles?
say:1:1430215101:1.source_cn: 除了萨洛克兰王城那些所谓的贵族还能有谁？
say:1:1430215101:1.male: Who else could it be besides those stinking nobles?
say:1:1430215101:1.female: Who else could it be besides those stinking nobles?

say:2:1430215102:1.text: We may be servants, but they cannot just treat us like vermin!
say:2:1430215102:1.source_cn: 我们虽然是仆从，但也不是任他们随意拿捏欺负的软蛋！
say:2:1430215102:1.male: We may be servants, but they cannot just treat us like vermin!
say:2:1430215102:1.female: We may be servants, but they cannot just treat us like vermin!

say:4:1430215103:1.text: But what else can we do? If we don't have a noble benefactor, we have to return to the commoners' district.
say:4:1430215103:1.source_cn: 可我们又能怎么办？如果不依附贵族，难道真的要回到平民区吗？
